data: Create an original, severely abstract dark cubist mural as one rough painted surface, using the first reference image as the composition and style guide for its compressed shallow space, irregular silhouette, charcoal-black ground, dirty-ivory figure, and stark hand gesture. Build the entire scene from charcoal-black, dirty ivory, warm chalk, ash-gray, and smoke-gray. Place Liu centrally as the protagonist, preserving the reference figure’s raised arm and warning gesture while transforming Liu into a broad, distorted body with one arm thrust upward and an open hand raised in warning, fingers spread. Construct Liu’s face from fractured, asymmetrical planes, hollow eyes, hooked marks, and displaced features. Surround Liu with enormous interlocking crescent shapes, jagged wedges, broken arcs, and angular slabs that press inward and overlap. Suggest a confronting second figure through a second fractured face and heavy limb emerging from the opposite side, without separating it into a conventional character. Run the composition along an oblique diagonal from lower frame-left toward upper frame-right, creating forced movement and tension. Fuse figures and setting into unstable worn plaster, with raw charcoal streaks, scraped pigment, chipped edges, smudged transitions, and broken brush marks. Use no national symbols, lettering, or readable text.
